title: The Secret Map of the Elements
intro: This quiz checks what you learned about the periodic table — groups, periods, atomic number, and types of elements.

questions.prompt: How are elements arranged in the modern periodic table?
questions.explanation: In the modern periodic table, elements are arranged by increasing atomic number.

questions.prompt: What are the horizontal rows of the periodic table called?
questions.explanation: Horizontal rows of the periodic table are called periods.

questions.prompt: What are the vertical columns of the periodic table called?
questions.explanation: Vertical columns of the periodic table are called groups.

questions.prompt: What does an element's atomic number tell us?
questions.explanation: Atomic number tells us the number of protons in an atom.

questions.prompt: Which type of element is usually shiny and a good conductor of heat and electricity?
questions.explanation: Metals are usually shiny and good conductors of heat and electricity.
